target_1_the_roll_window_causal_or_coinc.test_1_a_better_partition_exists_on_the_: Partition the block by SESSION instead of by calendar: 0708 + 0709 + 0710 = -3,230, which is 98 percent of the block cum -3,290. target_1_the_roll_window_causal_or_coinc.what_a_positive_last_roll_day_says_about: Two things, and the second is the one that matters. The tradeable object is therefore ph3 flow sign and its impact coefficient, both observable in real time - not a date range. (2) The stronger point: my +200 is NOT a roll-relief rally. If five days of mechanical supply had genuinely been holding the price down, its removal would have released a coefficient back toward the block's week-1 aligned median 0.380, which on +3,747 of flow is +1,400. The realized coefficient was 0.053. Nothing was released because nothing was being held. The roll's total price footprint in this block is on the order of tens of dollars, and my day is where you can see it because it is the day the mechanism had to show itself and did not.

target_3_the_burn_conversion_gate_adjudi.my_standing: Mine is the awkward instance the run directive wants adjudicated: the gate's limbs are SATISFIED on my day (CDD add +0.39/+1.233/+1.573/+1.598 at h0-h3; est_gas_burn_bcfd 43.3 vs 42.3 in the gate's own same-day-class Sunday-over-Sunday form = +1.0 Bcf/d; wind up moderately, and the gate says wind is a damper never a sorter) AND the day delivered +200 up. Three specialists have refuted the gate on days that failed. I am the one who has to say whether a day that WORKED rescues it.
target_3_the_burn_conversion_gate_adjudi.verdict: IT DOES NOT. My day is the fourth refutation, and it is the most damaging kind, because the gate got the sign right here and still cannot claim the day.
target_3_the_burn_conversion_gate_adjudi.refutation_1_TIMING: The gate is a transmission claim: heat -> burn -> gas call -> price. Then the price response must appear when the information becomes actionable. The batch is stamped 2026-07-13T23:59Z and is actionable from roughly 04:30 ET. Served ph1 (20:00 through ~07:00, the entire window in which that information was the newest thing in the market): pxchg EXACTLY 0 on +622 of signed buy flow. The market priced the burn-confirmed CDD add at zero. It then made its SESSION LOW at 09:07, after the information was fully digested. The day's entire net was built between 09:07 and 15:36 - the US day session, hours after the weather had come and gone. A transmission mechanism that produces nothing on arrival and everything six hours later is not the mechanism producing it.
target_3_the_burn_conversion_gate_adjudi.refutation_2_AMPLITUDE_on_the_gates_own_: The gate's call is explicit: 'burn-confirmed slope lean = full band.' Its band comes from its own G22 evidence: 0624 +800, 0630 +780, 0703 +410. My burn-confirmed day delivered +200 - half the bottom of the gate's calibrated band, and a quarter of its top. IN FAIRNESS TO THE GATE, its damper limb was correctly engaged and I verified the inputs myself rather than inheriting them: US48 burn 43.3 Bcf/d on 2026-07-12 against 42.3 on 2026-07-05 (+1.0, the gate's required same-day-class Sunday-over-Sunday form), with wind 876,016 MWh against 673,061 - up 30 percent, so 'wind is a damper never a sorter' fired and the blind sized down to +280 accordingly. That is the gate operating exactly as specified. It still over-sized the day by 40 percent AFTER its own damper was applied, and its unmodified call would have over-sized by 2x to 4x. A gate whose magnitude output must be overridden downward by its own user on the instance where it fires, and is still too big afterwards, is not carrying magnitude information.
target_3_the_burn_conversion_gate_adjudi.refutation_3_THE_FORWARD_DAYS_ARE_THE_RE: The CDD adds I was handed were for D1/D2/D3 = 0715 (+1.233, the 17.545 peak), 0716 (+1.573) and 0717 (+1.598) - the largest forward adds in the block. Those are the days the heat actually lands. They delivered -60, -20 and +180: one hundred dollars across the three days that carried the strongest burn-confirmed CDD extension of the entire group. The gate's fired signal has a forward footprint of +300 total across four sessions, in a block that fell -3,290.
target_3_the_burn_conversion_gate_adjudi.refutation_4_SUFFICIENCY_the_weather_ter: My +200 is fully reproduced with no weather term at all: session signed flow +3,747 times the coefficient carried from the prior session's terminal phase (0.026 pure, 0.045 with the declared roll-completion restoration) = +97 to +169. To reach the gate's full band you need a coefficient of 0.11 to 0.21, which this tape demonstrably did not have on the day before, the day of, or the day after. When a mechanical account with no free parameters reproduces the number and the fundamental account requires the wrong coefficient, the fundamental account is not doing the work.
target_3_the_burn_conversion_gate_adjudi.on_the_denominator_argument_my_day_sharp: The prior specialists said burn is a numerator with no balance-clearing denominator. My day supplies the size of the mismatch: a +1.0 Bcf/d burn improvement (2.3 percent of a 43.3 Bcf/d burn) against storage 2,983 with the print running +5.0 above and the curve in backwardation with 11 days to expiry. The numerator moved by roughly one percent of one week's injection while the denominator did not move at all. That is why the CDD-add limb 'is positive 20/20 days and therefore cannot gate' - in an injection-phase summer the numerator is ALWAYS positive and always small relative to what it must clear. This is a structural defect in the gate's construction, not a bad run of days.
target_3_the_burn_conversion_gate_adjudi.what_i_will_concede_to_the_gate: One thing, and it is small. The gate's SIGN limb is 1-for-1 on my day and I did keep the sign. But sign agreement on a single instance, produced by a mechanism I have separately shown is timing-inconsistent and amplitude-wrong, and separately reproducible from flow alone, is not evidence. Counting it as a hit would be exactly the tent-widening the operating discipline forbids. Scoreboard across the four refine adjudications: 0 of 4 clean up-fires deliver on the gate's own terms; mine is the only one that delivered the SIGN and it fails three of four causal tests.
target_3_the_burn_conversion_gate_adjudi.attribution_fence_honored_explicitly: The S110 ladder graft (ladder_graft_basis, A11.1) changed the CDD inputs, so I bank neither credit nor blame on the CDD numbers themselves. Note that none of my four refutations depend on them: refutation 1 is price timing versus a publication stamp; refutation 2 is the gate's own G22-calibrated band versus a realized net; refutation 3 is four realized day moves; refutation 4 is order flow times a measured coefficient. The grafted CDD values are used only to establish that a burn-confirmed add EXISTED - which is the premise most favourable to the gate. The refutation survives the fence intact.
target_3_the_burn_conversion_gate_adjudi.constructive_replacement_not_just_a_kill: The gate is trying to solve a magnitude problem with a fundamental input. Magnitude on this tape belongs to the impact coefficient, which is measurable, pre-cutoff-visible and calibrated across two groups (proposal 1). I would keep a burn/wind read as a weak SIGN prior with the magnitude claim WITHDRAWN, and let the coefficient carry the size. That is a strictly smaller claim than the gate makes and it is the one the evidence supports.

proposal_contribution:
FIVE proposals, as text only. No brain edit is made or implied. Each carries n, scope, falsifier, and what it does NOT claim.

--- PROPOSAL 1 (PRIMARY, and the one I would actually stake) ---
ID: magnitude.terminal_impact_coefficient_carry
STATUS: PROPOSED. This is a MAGNITUDE lever. It is SIGN-FREE by construction and must never be used as a sign justification.
TRIGGER: any next-session magnitude sizing where the prior session's phase table is served.
READ: define k3 = |prior session ph3 price change| / |prior session ph3 signed flow|, the tape's marginal price impact per unit of aggressor imbalance at the session's terminal phase. Require |ph3 flow| >= 500 lots so the ratio is measured on real flow rather than noise. k3 CARRIES ACROSS THE OVERNIGHT SEAM. It is the market's current exchange rate between flow and price, and it is a state, not a forecast.
CALL: when k3_prev <= 0.05 (the NUMB class), expect a SMALL next-day move: |day move| <= ~200 USD. Point estimate = (session signed flow) x k3_prev. Say nothing about sign.
EVIDENCE, per instance, never pooled as the conclusion. Numb instances across the staged groups, n=6 spanning g20 and g23: g20 0528->0529 (k3 0.043, f3 3762) next -160; g20 0601->0602 (k3 0.022, f3 1830) next -70; g20 0604->0605 (k3 0.032, f3 2816) next -1350; g23 0713->0714 (k3 0.026, f3 1162) next +200 [MY DAY]; g23 0714->0715 (k3 0.018, f3 1128) next -50; g23 0715->0716 (k3 0.036, f3 3342) next -20. Five of six land at or under 200 USD; median 115.
CALIBRATION AGAINST BASE RATE (this is what makes it a claim rather than an observation): across all 40 staged sessions in g20-g23 the median |day net| is 535 and only 12 of 40 days (30 percent) come in at or under 200. The numb limb hits 5 of 6 (83 percent). The lift is real and it is large.
THE ONE FAILURE, named and not explained away: g20 0604->0605 delivered -1350. I decline to invent a scope condition to rescue it - the obvious candidate (exclude numb phases that terminate a large absorption day, 0604 being +1140 on -5662 of flow) would also exclude g20 0528, which is a hit. The honest statement is 5 of 6 with one live counterexample, and the counterexample is the reason the rule is a lever and not a gate.
CONVERSE LIMB, weaker, n=2 spanning two groups: k3_prev >= 0.50 on f3 >= 500 gives g22 0623->0624 (+790) and g23 0708->0709 (-2050). Both large. Suggestive of a two-sided coefficient reading; not claimable at n=2.
WHAT IT DOES NOT CLAIM: nothing about direction. The six numb instances split five down and one up, and the one up is mine - a specialist claiming sign off his own single positive instance would be doing exactly what the walk's block-lean misses did.
SCOPE: NG, injection/summer era as measured (g20 late May-early June, g23 July). Requires the served phase table. HDD-season behaviour unmeasured.
BLIND-USABILITY - the reason this matters: k3_prev is computed entirely from the PRIOR session's phase table, which is pre-cutoff information. This is not a refine-only quantity. It can go into the blind's hands directly, and that is the point of proposing it.
FALSIFIER: a seam where k3_prev <= 0.05 on f3 >= 500 and the next session moves >= 700 USD absent an exogenous catalyst. A second instance of the 0605 class demotes this to a catalyst-conditional rule.
FORWARD TEST: G24+.

--- PROPOSAL 2 ---
ID: structure.void_precedes_impact_collapse
STATUS: HYPOTHESIS (n=2 for the sequence; duration NOT claimed).
TRIGGER: a session phase that reprices >= 800 USD on |net signed flow| <= 200 - the liquidity-void signature D and C-0708 identified on 0709.
READ: the void is price DISCOVERING the level at which real resting liquidity sits. Within one to two sessions the impact coefficient collapses by an order of magnitude at the NEW level and the tape goes numb in BOTH directions. The void and the numbness are the same event seen at two moments: the book being found empty, then the book being found.
EVIDENCE: scanning all four staged groups for the signature returns exactly two instances. g23 0709 ph2: -1860 on -11 net flow across 98,400 lots, followed by 0710 k3 0.302 then 0713 k3 0.026. g20 0529 ph3: -810 on -59 across 60,930 lots, followed by 0601 k3 0.022. n=2 spanning two groups for the SEQUENCE.
WHAT IT DOES NOT CLAIM: duration. g20's numb state lasted one session (0603 +760 and 0604 +1140 followed); g23's lasted at least four. Anyone using this to hold a quiet-tape view for a week is over-reading it.
WHY IT IS WORTH PROPOSING: it makes a prediction the void reading alone does not - quiet in BOTH directions, not merely lower. G23's second week is the confirming case: session flows of +3747, +6326, +1089, +1333 producing +200, -60, -20, +180.
FALSIFIER: a void followed within two sessions by a >= 700 USD move at a restored coefficient.

--- PROPOSAL 3 (upgrade of an existing PROPOSED play) ---
ID: handoff.residual_tilt_field - GENERALIZE the trigger and REPLACE the justification.
CURRENT FORM: on program days (index roll, BCOM), do not consume the D-1 raw aggregate signed flow as a directional tilt; decontaminate by cohort. n=2, and both instances were executed as a declared PROXY because tape_conditions carries no cohort decomposition.
PROPOSED FORM: DISCOUNT A D-1 TILT BY ITS REALIZED PRICE IMPACT, NOT BY ITS PROVENANCE. If the prior session's terminal phase moved a large signed flow for negligible price (k3 numb), that flow carries no directional information regardless of its sign, size, or whether a program can be blamed for it. The tape did not price it; that is the measurement.
WHY REPLACE THE JUSTIFICATION: provenance is an attribution we cannot make - the cohort field does not exist in the served state, which is why both existing instances are proxies. Impact is a measurement we already have. The measured form needs no new feed.
WHY GENERALIZE THE TRIGGER: I tested D-1 aggregate signed-flow SIGN against next-day net SIGN across all 36 staged seams in g20-g23. It agrees 16 times out of 36 - 44 percent, a coin flip, and it is a coin flip in BOTH sub-classes (2 of 6 numb, 14 of 30 non-numb). The D-1 aggregate flow sign, taken alone, carries no next-day directional information anywhere in this sample. The play is therefore not a roll-day special case; it is a general instruction not to consume that quantity as a tilt, and roll days are simply where its failure was first noticed.
MY DAY AS THE INSTANCE: 0713 aggregate -950 with phase-3 acceleration -1162 read DOWN raw. The blind discounted it by provenance and was right; the measured reason is k3 = 0.026. Next-day sign +.
WHAT IT DOES NOT CLAIM: that some OTHER D-1 tilt object (big-print b-share, phase concentration, absorption structure) is uninformative. My test is narrow and specific to the aggregate sign, and I want that scope kept tight.
FALSIFIER: a group in which D-1 aggregate flow sign predicts next-day sign at 65 percent or better on n >= 10.

--- PROPOSAL 4 ---
ID: calendar.index_roll_window_is_a_container_not_a_cause
STATUS: PROPOSED, n=1 block executed as a causal test (g23) - deliberately NOT claimed at n=2, because the honest instance count is one and the walk has been burned by rules that generalized off a single block.
TRIGGER: any block or day where a GSCI/BCOM roll window is calendar-visible, and any temptation to attribute a block's drift to it.
READ: an index roll is a CALENDAR SPREAD. Its outright price contribution is bounded by the roll flow's price productivity in the settle phase, which is directly measurable as ph3 flow times k3. A roll-window sum that appears to 'explain' a block is an arithmetic coincidence of containment unless the moves inside it are themselves flow-driven at a measured coefficient.
THE TEST, three parts, all executed on g23: (a) find a tighter partition on the same data - 0708+0709+0710 = -3230 = 98 percent of the block in three consecutive sessions, versus five calendar days for 111 percent; (b) strip the flush and measure the window's own residual - 0713 session -260 plus 0714 +200 = -60 USD, after removing the -360 weekend gap which is a seam, not roll selling; (c) test the window's LAST day, where a mechanical program must still be executing - settle-phase flow flipped from -1162 to +1128 and the day closed +200. Also: on BD8, 1162 lots of net sell in the settle phase moved price 30 USD, so the bid was DEFENDED during roll supply, which refutes the softer 'the roll left the bid undefended' form as well.
CALL: quote a roll window as a GOVERNOR on conviction and on expected settle-phase noise. Never as a sign, never as a block-drift attribution.
FALSIFIER: a roll window whose settle phases reproduce the day nets at a measured coefficient (ph3 flow x k3 accounting for the bulk of the move). That would make the roll causal and I would want to see it.
DATA REQUEST attached: the counterparty leg. Only NGQ26 is staged; a real roll decomposition needs NGU26 alongside it, and the calendar-spread series. Without it, roll questions can only ever be answered negatively.

--- PROPOSAL 5 ---
ID: weather.burn_conversion_gate - WITHDRAW the amplitude limb; retain at most a weak sign prior.
STATUS: the gate is now 0 for 4 on clean up-fires across four independent refine adjudications, and mine is the one that DELIVERED the sign and still fails.
WHAT TO WITHDRAW: 'burn-confirmed slope lean = full band'. On my day the gate's limbs were satisfied, its calibrated band (from its own G22 evidence: +800, +780, +410) called for full band, and the day delivered +200 - below the band's floor. The blind that fired it had already overridden it downward to +280 on judgement. A magnitude call that its own user must override on the instance where it fires is not carrying magnitude.
WHY THE SIGN LIMB SHOULD ALSO BE HELD LOOSELY: my +200 is reproducible from flow times the carried coefficient with no weather term (97 to 169 USD, no free parameters), and the price timing contradicts the transmission - the burn-confirmed CDD add was priced at EXACTLY ZERO during the overnight phase in which it was the market's newest information, and the session low came at 09:07, AFTER it was digested. And the forward days that actually carried the heat (0715/0716/0717, the block's largest CDD adds at +1.233/+1.573/+1.598) delivered -60, -20, +180.
THE STRUCTURAL DIAGNOSIS, which is the useful part: the gate's numerator is always positive and always small in an injection-phase summer. A +1.0 Bcf/d burn improvement is 2.3 percent of burn, against storage 2,983 running +5.0 above on the print, injection phase, backwardation, 11 days to expiry. The CDD-add limb being positive 20 of 20 days is not bad luck; it is what that limb does in that season, which is why it cannot gate.
CONSTRUCTIVE REPLACEMENT: the gate is trying to solve a MAGNITUDE problem with a FUNDAMENTAL input. Magnitude belongs to proposal 1, which is measurable, pre-cutoff-visible, and calibrated across two groups. Keep burn/wind as a weak sign prior with the magnitude claim removed, and let the coefficient carry size.
ATTRIBUTION FENCE, stated on the record: the S110 ladder graft changed the CDD inputs, so I bank neither credit nor blame on those values. None of the four refutations depends on them - they rest on price timing versus a publication stamp, the gate's own G22 band versus a realized net, four realized day moves, and order flow times a measured coefficient. The grafted CDD values are used only to grant the gate its premise.

--- CROSS-CUTTING ---
The thread through all five: THIS BLOCK'S SECOND WEEK IS A MAGNITUDE PROBLEM MISDIAGNOSED AS A DIRECTION PROBLEM. The run directive's headline is that G23's blind leaned UP +4900 while the block fell -3290 with 83 percent of error surviving netting. My day says the lean is not where the damage is. Seven of the block's ten sessions net -60 in total; 98 percent of the block was made in three consecutive sessions. On the other seven, the tape's exchange rate between flow and price had collapsed by an order of magnitude, and any forecaster - blind or refined - sizing those days off fundamental bands rather than off the measured coefficient will be wrong by a multiple regardless of which way it leans. The fix is not a better direction rule. It is to put the prior session's terminal impact coefficient in front of the blind and let it size.
